title: feat(advisory-convergence): opt-in applicability exemption for bot-authored PRs with no claim history
body:
## Background

Sibling issue #1905 (part of roadmap #1904) adds a claimless
`idd-external-check-waiver` marker so a trusted maintainer can manually
unblock a stuck `idd-advisory-convergence` check on a pull request that never
carried an IDD claim -- most concretely, an automated dependency-update PR
(Dependabot, Renovate, ImgBot, or similar) opened under the documented
default `advisoryWait.convergenceScope: "all-prs"`.

That still requires one human action per stuck PR/HEAD. For a repository
that receives frequent automated dependency PRs, that does not scale: every
PR whose primary-bot review never lands (see roadmap #1904's
Background for the community-reported reason this can happen for bot-authored
PRs) would need a fresh maintainer-posted marker. This issue adds a
fully-automatic, **opt-in** applicability exemption, scoped narrowly enough
to leave the check's normal guarantees untouched for anything that could
plausibly be IDD-relevant.

The codebase already fetches `author { login __typename }` via GraphQL to
distinguish Bot-typed authors for review threads
(`src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`, the queries around lines ~1954 and
~2022), but the PR's *own* author is currently fetched only through
`gh pr view --json headRefOid,headRefName,closingIssuesReferences,author,url`
(around line ~1412-1413), whose `author` field carries only `login` -- no
type information. New GraphQL plumbing is needed to expose the PR-level
author's `__typename`.

`claimMarkerHistoryPresent` is already computed once per verdict
(`hasTrustedClaimMarkerHistory`, threaded into `computeAdvisoryConvergence-
Verdict` as an input, see `AdvisoryConvergenceInputs.claimMarkerHistoryPresent`
around line ~427) and is the exact "no claim ever existed for this PR"
signal the existing `idd-claimed` applicability branch already relies on for
its own `not_applicable` classification (`idd-claimed-no-verified-linked-
issue-claim`). This issue reuses that same signal rather than introducing a
parallel one.

## Proposed change

- Add a new boolean policy field `advisoryWait.exemptBotAuthoredPrs`
  (default `false` -- no behavior change for any repository that does not
  explicitly opt in), validated in `schemas/policy.schema.json` and
  normalized in `src/scripts/policy-helpers.mts` alongside the existing
  `convergenceScope` field it sits next to.
- In `collectFromGitHub` / the PR-fetch path in
  `src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`, fetch the PR-level author's
  `__typename` (`Bot` vs `User`) via a small GraphQL query addition, and
  thread a normalized `prAuthorIsBot: boolean` (or equivalent) into
  `AdvisoryConvergenceInputs`.
- In `computeAdvisoryConvergenceVerdict`'s applicability computation
  (`src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`, the `applicability` object around
  lines 605-652), add a new branch scoped to **`convergenceScope ===
  'all-prs'` only** -- `idd-claimed` scope already resolves a PR with no
  claim marker history to `not_applicable` via its existing
  `idd-claimed-no-verified-linked-issue-claim` branch, so extending the new
  branch to `idd-claimed` as well would just replace that existing, already-
  correct reason token on an already-`not_applicable` output for no
  behavioral gain -- avoid that output churn entirely by leaving every
  `idd-claimed` branch untouched. Within the `all-prs` branch: when
  `options.exemptBotAuthoredPrs` is `true` AND the PR author is Bot-typed AND
  `claimMarkerHistoryPresent === false`, set `applicability: { status:
  'not_applicable', reason: 'bot-authored-no-claim-history' }`. When the
  flag is off, or either condition doesn't hold, leave today's `all-prs`
  behavior (`status: 'applicable', reason: 'all-prs'`) completely unchanged
  -- in particular, a Bot-typed author that DOES have claim marker history
  (however it got there) must never be exempted, and a human-authored PR
  must never be exempted regardless of the flag.
- Update `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`'s applicability/not-applicable-reasons
  table, `docs/policy-constants.md`, `docs/customization.md`, and
  `.github/instructions/idd-advisory-wait.instructions.md` (plus their
  `idd-template/` mirrors) to document the new opt-in field, its default,
  and its exact precondition.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With `exemptBotAuthoredPrs: true` and `convergenceScope: 'all-prs'`, a
      PR whose author resolves to a GitHub Bot-typed account and has no
      claim marker history produces `applicability: { status:
      'not_applicable', reason: 'bot-authored-no-claim-history' }` and
      `ready: true`.
- [ ] With `convergenceScope: 'idd-claimed'`, the new flag never changes any
      existing `idd-claimed` applicability outcome or reason token --
      including for a Bot-typed author with no claim history, which already
      resolves to `not_applicable` via the pre-existing
      `idd-claimed-no-verified-linked-issue-claim` branch.
- [ ] With the flag unset or `false` (the default), every existing test case
      in `tests/advisory-convergence.test.mts` produces byte-identical
      output to today.
- [ ] A Bot-typed-author PR under `all-prs` scope that DOES have claim
      marker history is not exempted even with the flag on.
- [ ] A human-authored PR under `all-prs` scope is never exempted regardless
      of the flag.
- [ ] New tests in `tests/advisory-convergence.test.mts` cover: flag-on
      Bot-author-and-no-claim exemption under `all-prs`, flag-on
      Bot-author-with-claim-history no-exemption under `all-prs`, flag-on
      human-author no-exemption under `all-prs`, flag-on no-output-change
      under `idd-claimed`, and flag-off no-behavior-change.
- [ ] `schemas/policy.schema.json` documents `exemptBotAuthoredPrs` with its
      default and description; `tests/schema-type-reconciliation.test.mts`
      (or the schema test covering `advisoryWait`) passes.
- [ ] Documentation updated in the files listed above;
      `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm run lint:minimum` pass;
      `scripts/advisory-convergence.mjs` and `scripts/policy-helpers.mjs`
      are regenerated via `pnpm run build`.

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`
- `src/scripts/policy-helpers.mts`
- `schemas/policy.schema.json`
- `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`, `docs/policy-constants.md`,
  `docs/customization.md` (+ `idd-template/` mirrors)
- `.github/instructions/idd-advisory-wait.instructions.md` (+
  `idd-template/` mirror)
- `tests/advisory-convergence.test.mts`

Refs #1563, #1564, #1567

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- well-specified schema, plumbing, and
classification change reusing an existing computed signal, with
deterministic test coverage; the GraphQL query addition is the only genuinely
new plumbing._
